# DSH Plugins

> **ARCHIVED 2026-10-26 — this repository is read-only.**
>
> It served two purposes and both have r

un their course:
>
> - **Plugins** — `skill-fuzzy-match` was retired (DSH core ≥ 0.2.0 ships
>   nat

ive `rankByName` in `dsh-client-ui-primitives`, called directly by
>   `dsh-client-ui-skill`; see
>

deepseek-harness#4490).
>   It is removed from this tree and remains only in git history. Active
>

plugin development lives in its own repositories — e.g.
>   `amazing-fish/dsh-piano-nav`,
>   `am

azing-fish/dsh-sysnotify`.
> - **Patches** — `patches/` was a mirror of one machine's local
>   patc

h library. The authoritative copy is (and always was)
>   `~/.dsh/patches` on that machine (`PATCHES

.md` + `check-patches.ps1`);
>   the files here are reference diffs kept for history. **No further s

ync
>   will be pushed to this repository** — anything newer than the last commit
>   exists only in

that local library.
>
> Nothing here is needed to run DSH. Clone it if you want the historical
> di
ffs; do not expect updates.
A historical collection of plugins and UI extensions for DeepSeek Harness, plus reference diffs for
environment patches.
## Plugins (as of archival)
| Plugin | Description | Status |

| Memo | Persistent, draggable four-zone memo window with light/dark theme support | Historical |
|
~~Skill Fuzzy Match~~ | Made the `/` slash menu match skills by subsequence instead of name prefix |
**Removed 2026-10-26** — obsolete since DSH 0.2.0 (native `rankByName`); npm package `@amazing-fish
/dsh-plugin-skill-fuzzy-match@0.1.x` is deprecated |
## Patches

`patches/` holds reference diffs for environment patches applied
directly to installed packages (DSH

core, the Mnemon memory stack, the
Hindsight daemon, FlashRank) — too small for plugins, too easy t

o lose on
reinstall. See the patches index for the full list,
version anchors, and wipe/re-apply rul

es. **Snapshot only — further patches
are applied locally and are not mirrored here.**
## Installing a plugin (npm / GitHub Packages)

Historical instructions, retained for reference. Configure the `@amazing-fish`
scope, then install w
ith your package manager:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then add a plugin row to your DSH profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH (or reload the profile) to mount it.
## Repository layout

Each plugin lived under `plugins/<name>` and could contain separate Host and
Client Cordis packages.

Plugins also published to npm carried a `package.json`
with `publishConfig.registry=https://npm.pkg

published to npm carried a `package.json`
with `publishConfig.registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com`.
## Compatibility

The archived sources targeted the DeepSeek Harness workspace APIs used by
`0.1.0-rc.5`. DSH plugin A

PIs have moved on since; treat everything here as
historical.
